profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Criteo
profile.summary:
- Over 5+ years of IT experience in custom application analysis, design, development and maintenance
 - Experienced in developing Client Server, Web based applications using various technologies like ASP.NET with C#, SQL Server, MVC Framework, AJAX
 - Expertise in front-end technologies including JavaScript, HTML, CSS, JQuery, Bootstrap.
 - Good experience in various relational database designs, writing complex SQL and PL/SQL,and strong data analysis skill.
 - Hands on experience with developing Web applications, Windows Forms application, Database Procedures & Triggers, Web Services.
 - Ability to co-ordinate and work with team members on the application development projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for creating custom, general use modules and components which extend the elements and modules of core Angular JS and Typescripts.
* Developed the Application using ASP.NET MVC 4.0, Entity Framework, Used LINQ for querying, sorting, filtering the complex objects utilizing Entity Framework DB Context.
* Worked in an agile environment and attending daily scrum meetings to discuss current projects and
address any problems we might be encountering.
* Participated in design and code reviews and update documents with unit testing results of application or enhancements.

positions.title: Front End Developer as Intern
positions.description:
* Responsible for creating and updating HTML/.erb files to work with the company's Ruby on Rails backend from layouts created in Photoshop.
* Created front-end user interfaces with HTML/HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, SCSS to achieve a responsive design.
* Tested front-end code in multiple browsers to ensure cross-browser compatibility.
* Analyzed traffic and made necessary changes for a better user experience.
* Evaluated code to ensure that it is valid, is properly structured, meets industry standards and is compatible with browsers, devices or operating systems.
* Helped implementation of best practices version control using GitHub.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Worked with the development managers on designing module architecture, user interfaces, and 
   overall look and feel of the modules in existing product.
* Assisted in development of back end features ASP.NET with C#, SQL Server, MVC, AJAX.
* Developed fully functional responsive prototypes based on Business Requirements.
* Experience with working in agile methodology.
* Participated in design, code reviews and updated the SRS documents with unit test cases of 
   application or enhancements.
* Helped create and implement new ideas for ways to grow business and generate revenue.

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.description:
* Developed the Web Application using ASP.net with C# and SQL Server.
* Implemented web pages and banners from design mockups using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JQuery.
* Designed and architected SQL database for integration system in MS SQL Server, wrote all stored procedures to support standard CRUD data operations.
* Analyzed testing impacts of requirement changes and modified test scenarios as needed adhering to the SDLC methodologies.
* Executed SQL queries to test back end data validation of database tables based on business requirements.
* Fixed front end bugs (HTML, CSS, JavaScript errors) and Unit testing.

educations.schoolName: Cal State LA College of ECST

projects.title: Directory Management System (AngularJS, Node.JS, NPM, Javascript, AJAX, HTML5, CSS3)
projects.description:
• This application - Directory Management System is alike C-Panel which is useful as its name says. 

• This is a very handy application alike C-Panel through which we can access our file explorer (All Drives which are on our Computer) through web-browser using AngularJS functionalities like Controllers, Directives, Factories and several other features with the end help of Node.JS and especially useful NPM modules like FS-Extra.

projects.title: TVMAZE Application (AngularJS, Node.JS, NPM, Javascript, AJAX, HTML5, CSS3, JSON)
projects.description:
• As it was a quarter long project we have continuously implemented a web application using Angular JS controller, directive and several other features with help of Node JS. 

• Using application can search for any TV-Show and details accordingly along with TV-Show summary and all its Cast Member - Details with images whichever is available and gives relative links as on TVMaze API.

 • Furthermore, it saves browser specific search history without duplication of any search history.
